lastSessionSummary: S177 (2026-09-11, from SIL ledger): Total: 950/1000 | Velocity: 5.
lastShipped: Classic Survival has its own original-game card and play button; alternate modes and survival challenges share a readable desktop/mobile picker. Descriptions explain Boss Rush warmups, endless Timed Survival, optional Boss Gauntlet par, Extraction exit thresholds and Throne retry; numeric copy stays derived from gameplay facts. Boss Gauntlet opens with a boss and advances through six distinct solo fights; the sixth defeat ends in victory without a seventh wave. Throne recovery reactivates the first lost point after the remaining captures; a second loss ends the run. The retake notice fits mobile screens. Score Attack shows time remaining; Timed Survival shows tenths; clocks reset each run. Classic and Operations clear previously selected alternate-mode flags. Boss defeat effects use the existing runtime helper; App now rejects undefined references during lint. Boss intro geometry is centered and honors reduced motion.
truthStatus: Mode and prior visual/audio corrections verified; production deployed and verified.
